# sim-lib-server

`RawHttpServer` is the reusable host-facing HTTP boundary. It receives ordered
request facts from the existing `SocketPort`/`DnsPort` accept and parser organ,
pulls bounded request chunks, and writes bounded response chunks with write
completion as backpressure. Each invocation owns a child `Cancellation`; socket
adapters report peer loss and platform-clock deadline expiry through its
`RequestScope`. `ServerFrame` transports remain the compatibility service above
the same listener and parser.
